output.answer_markdown: Yes, based on the passages, Verizon appears capital intensive in FY2022: it invested $23.1 billion in capital expenditures during 2022, including about $6.2 billion of C-Band related spending [7]. The passages also show large ongoing capital needs, with a 2022 capital program guided at $16.5–$17.5 billion plus an additional $5.0–$6.0 billion for C-Band [5]. Long-term debt commitments were $150.2 billion as of December 31, 2021 [5]. The passages do not give FY2022 revenue or total assets, so capex intensity as a ratio cannot be computed from them.

provenance.quote: these investments included $23.1 billion for capital expenditures

claims.text: During the year ended December 31, 2022, Verizon's investments included $23.1 billion of capital expenditures.

provenance.quote: inclusive of approximately $6.2 billion in C-Band related capital expenditures

claims.text: The 2022 capital expenditures included approximately $6.2 billion of C-Band related capital expenditures.

provenance.quote: We anticipate cash requirements for our 2022 capital program to be between $16.5 billion and $17.5 billion.

claims.text: Verizon anticipated 2022 capital program cash requirements of $16.5 billion to $17.5 billion, plus an additional $5.0 billion to $6.0 billion related to C-Band.

provenance.quote: Long-term debt, including current maturities, commitments of $150.2 billion

claims.text: Verizon's long-term debt commitments, including current maturities, were $150.2 billion as of December 31, 2021.
